qualification: Observed single-run live differences; peer demand and connection histories varied. Requested Rust heap; abandoned-stream deadline remains experimental.
rate_units_correction: Raw upload_bps is bits/second. Traffic buckets use >=524288 bit/s for active upload and <=8192 bit/s for quiet. Earlier commentary mislabeled raw rates as bytes/second.
scope: Benefits target retained closing transports and excess table capacity during normal operation. Stable healthy idle connections showed essentially unchanged memory. Controlled transfer runs are rate-limited and do not establish peak throughput parity.
